[card-lost-stolen-v2] Lost or stolen card (effective 2025-11-01)
If your card is lost or stolen, you can deal with it in the app in a couple of minutes. You don't need to call us.

## What to do

1. **Freeze the card.** Tap Cards and switch Freeze card on. This stops new purchases right away.
2. **Report it.** If you can't find it, tap Report lost or stolen. This cancels the card permanently. It can't be undone.
3. **Add a virtual card.** You can create one in the app and use it online and in mobile wallets right away while the

[card-lost-stolen-v2] Lost or stolen card (effective 2025-11-01)
one in the app and use it online and in mobile wallets right away while the replacement ships.
4. **Order a replacement.** Pick standard or expedited shipping. Replacement and shipping fees depend on your plan.
5. **Check your transactions.** Dispute anything you don't recognize.

## Delivery

Standard shipping takes 7 to 10 business days. Expedited shipping takes 2 to 3 business days.

## Unauthorized transactions

You're not responsible for unauthorized card transactions you report within 60 days of the statement they first appear on. If you found your card after freezing it,

[card-lost-stolen-v1] Lost or stolen card (effective 2024-01-01)
If your card is lost or stolen, call our card services line straight away so we can cancel it.

## What to do

1. Call card services at +1 555 0142. The line is open 24 hours a day.
2. The agent confirms your identity, cancels the card and orders a replacement.
3. Check your recent transactions in the app and tell the agent about any you don't recognize.

## Your replacement

The replacement card arrives in 7 to 10 business days. Basic members pay $5.00 for a replacement. Plus and Premium replacements are

[card-lost-stolen-v2] Lost or stolen card (effective 2025-11-01)
the statement they first appear on. If you found your card after freezing it, just unfreeze it. Nothing else changes.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

[card-lost-stolen-v1] Lost or stolen card (effective 2024-01-01)
Basic members pay $5.00 for a replacement. Plus and Premium replacements are free.

Until the new card arrives, you can use BrookPay and transfers from the app. Virtual cards aren't available.

## Unauthorized transactions

You're not responsible for unauthorized card transactions reported within 60 days of the statement they first appear on.

## Found your card?

Once a card is reported, it's cancelled for good, even if you find it later. Destroy it and wait for the replacement.

Questions? Our support team is available in the app at any hour.

[support-financial-abuse] If someone is controlling your money (effective 2025-01-01)
If someone is controlling your money, pressuring you to hand it over, or using your account without your permission, you're not alone, and we can help.

## Tell us safely

Message support in the app when it's safe. You can use a code phrase like "I need to talk about my account security" if someone might see your screen. Support will pass your case to our Account Services team, who are trained to help.

## What we can do

- Change your password and sign out other devices
- Freeze or replace your card
- Stop sending paper mail to

[card-freeze] Freezing and unfreezing your card (effective 2025-01-01)
Refunds from merchants
- Deposits and incoming transfers
- Your virtual card, which has its own freeze switch

## Freeze or report lost?

If you're sure the card is gone or stolen, report it lost or stolen instead. That cancels the card permanently and lets you order a replacement. A freeze is temporary and reversible.

## Freeze versus fraud lock

If the app says your card is locked by Tallowbrook, that's a fraud lock, not a freeze. You can't remove a fraud lock with the freeze switch. See "Why is my card locked

[card-virtual] Virtual cards (effective 2025-01-01)
freeze the virtual one.
- It can't be used at ATMs.
- Reporting your physical card lost or stolen doesn't cancel the virtual card.

## Replacing a virtual card

If you think the virtual card number has been exposed, delete it in the app and create a new one. There's no fee. Remember to update any merchants that stored the old number.

Limits and fees are the same as for your physical card, and virtual card spending counts toward the same daily card spending limit.

Need more help? Message us in the app any time, day or night.

Rules:
- Use only facts stated in the excerpts. Do not add fees, limits, dates, steps or products they do not mention.
- Some excerpts are older versions of a policy. When two excerpts disagree, follow the one with the later effective date.
- If the question depends on the customer's plan (Basic, Plus or Premium), use that plan's numbers.
- If the question rests on something false (for example a fee that does not exist), say so and give the correct facts. That is an answer, not an abstention.
- Abstain when the excerpts do not contain the answer, when the question is not about Tallowbrook, or when it asks for investment, tax or legal advice. Set "abstain" to true and say briefly that the help center does not cover it.
- Cite the article IDs (the text in square brackets) of every excerpt you used. Cite nothing when you abstain.
- Keep the answer short: two to four sentences, plain language.
